verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is a passing reference that 'ChatGPT data controls apply to content processed through ChatGPT, including screenshots taken by Computer Use,' implying some data-control/retention settings exist, but no documentation details how to view, export, or delete data, set retention periods, or manage memory deletion. Missing for 10: explicit data retention/export/delete documentation, memory deletion controls, and independent confirmation that these controls work as described.
